verdict.rationale: Multi-project portfolio roll-up is a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, but the evidence pack never documents a portfolio view or cross-project progress aggregation. The only related items are developer building blocks: API tutorials for building an app that reports on status updates, and an MCP server that can generate reports. These earn no credit toward a first-party portfolio view.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
